note: All items are fictional and constructed for teaching purposes. Audio is generated by the browser's speech synthesis (voice quality varies). The transcript is shown only after the learner answers. Each item has a reading equivalent with the same communicative goal for learners who are deaf or hard of hearing; this is an alternative, not equivalent listening practice (see design/accessibility-plan.md).

items.transcript: The ten fifteen train to Seaview will now leave from platform six, not platform four. Platform six for Seaview.
items.question: Where does the Seaview train leave from now?

options.why: Platform four was the old platform. The announcement changes it.
Correct. 'Will now leave from platform six, not platform four.'
Ten is part of the time (ten fifteen), not the platform.

reading.text: Screen at the station: SEAVIEW 10:15 - PLATFORM CHANGE - NOW PLATFORM 6 (was 4)

items.transcript: The bus stop? Go out of the main exit, turn right, and it's opposite the bank.
items.question: Where is the bus stop?

options.text: Out of the main exit, turn right, opposite the bank
options.why: Correct. You followed all three steps.

options.text: Out of the main exit, turn left, next to the bank
options.why: Listen again for 'right' and 'opposite'.

options.text: Inside the station, next to the café
options.why: The speaker says to go out of the main exit.

reading.text: Sign: BUS STOP - Exit via MAIN EXIT, turn RIGHT. The stop is OPPOSITE the bank.

items.transcript: Sorry, we've run out of the chocolate cake. We've still got lemon cake or apple pie.
items.question: What can't you order?

options.why: Lemon cake is still available.
Apple pie is still available.
Correct. 'We've run out of' means there is none left.

reading.text: Counter note: Sorry, NO MORE chocolate cake today. Lemon cake and apple pie still available.

items.transcript: The carrot cake is fine for nut allergies, but the banana bread has walnuts in it.
items.question: Your friend is allergic to nuts. Which is safe for her?

options.why: Correct. 'Fine for nut allergies.'
The banana bread 'has walnuts in it'. Walnuts are nuts.
Only one is nut-free. Listen for 'but'.

reading.text: Menu label: Carrot cake (NUT-FREE). Banana bread (CONTAINS WALNUTS).

items.transcript: Take two tablets with water, three times a day, after meals. Don't take more than six in a day.
items.question: How many tablets can you take in one day at most?

options.why: Two is for one time. You take them three times a day.
Three is how many times a day, not how many tablets.
Correct. 'Don't take more than six in a day.' (Fictional instructions, for language practice only.)

reading.text: Box (fictional, for language practice only): Take 2 tablets with water, 3 times a day, after meals. Do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours.

items.transcript: If you still feel ill after three days, or if you get a high temperature, please see a doctor.
items.question: When should you see a doctor?

options.why: The speaker gives two conditions. Listen for 'if'.

options.text: If you still feel ill after three days, or get a high temperature
options.why: Correct. You caught both conditions.

options.text: Only if you get a high temperature
options.why: That is one condition, but there are two.

reading.text: Leaflet (fictional): See a doctor if you still feel ill after 3 days, or if you get a high temperature.

items.transcript: Your room isn't ready yet, I'm afraid. Check-in is from two o'clock, but you can leave your bag here.
items.question: What can you do now?

options.why: The room 'isn't ready yet'.
Correct. 'You can leave your bag here.'
Check-in is from two o'clock.

reading.text: Reception sign: Check-in from 14:00. Early arrival? You can leave your bag at reception.

items.transcript: Your booking reference is K, seven, two, nine. That's K for kitchen, seven, two, nine.
items.question: What is the booking reference?

options.why: Correct. The speaker spelled it and gave 'K for kitchen' to help.
Listen to the order of the numbers: seven, two, nine.
'K for kitchen' tells you it is K, not C.

reading.text: Email: Your booking reference is K729 (K as in kitchen).
